europe_now.title: Serbia’s Student-Led Movement Wins Parliamentary Majority
europe_now.summary: Student-led protestors have won a parliamentary majority in Serbia, setting up a showdown with President Vučić ahead of December’s presidential poll. Vučić has conceded defeat to the student-led movement.

sources.headline: Serbia’s student protestors win parliamentary majority – setting scene for showdown with Vučić for December’s presidential poll
Serbia's Vucic concedes defeat to the student-led movement: What's next?

europe_now.title: France Faces Continued Student Unrest as Government Vows Response
europe_now.summary: France’s prime minister has met student representatives after weeks of protests. The government said it would maintain order without declaring a state of emergency, though Macron noted the option remains available.

sources.headline: Live: France will maintain order without state of emergency, but it’s not off the table, Macron says

top_stories.title: EU Commission Shake-Up Moves Closer Under Von der Leyen
top_stories.summary: Ursula von der Leyen’s proposed overhaul of the European Commission has moved a step closer to approval. The restructuring involves significant changes to the bloc’s executive leadership.

sources.headline: Von der Leyen’s big Commission shake-up moves a step closer

top_stories.title: Czech Government Approves Scrapping of Broadcast Licence Fees
top_stories.summary: The Czech government has approved the first step toward scrapping television and radio licence fees. The early-morning vote sparked protests against the planned reform.

sources.headline: Czech government approves first step to scrapping TV and radio licence fees in 4.36am vote, sparking protests

top_stories.title: Poland and Vietnam Announce Strategic Partnership
top_stories.summary: Poland and Vietnam have announced a strategic partnership during Prime Minister Tusk’s visit to Hanoi. The development was reported as part of the Polish leader’s official trip to Vietnam.

sources.headline: Poland and Vietnam announce strategic partnership during Tusk visit to Hanoi

top_stories.title: UK Politician Calls for Return to EU Within His Lifetime
top_stories.summary: Burnham has said he wants the United Kingdom to rejoin the European Union within his lifetime. The comment was made in remarks about the UK’s future relationship with the bloc.

sources.headline: Burnham wants UK back in EU within his lifetime
